manifest.title: Manifest
manifest.description: Absolute path to the installed native script package manifest. Set either manifest or command.

command.title: Command
command.description: Executable and fixed arguments for a script without a manifest. The executable must be an absolute path. Set either manifest or command.

mode.title: Execution mode
mode.description: Auto uses the manifest's mode or runs a direct command once per collection. Choose oneshot or persistent only for a direct command.

snapshot_format.title: Snapshot format
snapshot_format.description: Auto uses the manifest's snapshot format or JSON for a direct command. Choose json or lines only for a direct command.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: Retry interval in seconds for failed startup checks. Zero disables retries.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for startup and collection, including queue waiting. Admitted persistent collections get a full exchange timeout. Canceled Functions allow up to this timeout to drain their reply; callers still use their own deadline.

config.title: Package configuration
config.description: Values for the package configuration schema. Leave empty to use package defaults.
